name: SciMLBench
description: An open-source benchmarking suite for evaluating machine learning algorithms on scientific tasks drawn from national laboratory datasets. Each benchmark is a full ML application (not a micro-benchmark) covering materials science, life sciences, environmental science, particle physics, and astronomy. Emphasizes reproducibility, FAIR-compliant datasets, and HPC-level logging.
domain: AI for science, materials science, climate, biology, particle physics
evaluation_method: framework-level logging; task-specific ML accuracy metrics plus computational performance
reputation: Published in Nature Reviews Physics (2022); used by STFC Rutherford Appleton Laboratory and the Alan Turing Institute; recognized benchmark in the AI-for-science community
notes: Distinct from the Julia SciML ODE-solver benchmarks. Focuses on real scientific datasets rather than synthetic tasks. Supports TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, and Apache MXNet. GitHub: github.com/stfc-sciml/sciml-bench
